description: Lab tests dated on 1985-04-22 or on 1994-03-14 are included in the range, along with every test between them.

c.request: For laboratory tests between 1985-04-22 and 1994-03-14 (comparing the `Date` text as stored), what is the average hemoglobin (`HGB`) and the average total bilirubin-to-creatinine ratio (`T-BIL` ÷ `CRE`, per test) for each anti-centromere status (`CENTROMEA`, with a missing status as its own group)? Also give each status's average ratio divided by the plain mean of all the statuses' average ratios. Ignore missing values in the averages, return nothing if that overall mean is missing, and don't round. Lab tests dated on 1985-04-22 or on 1994-03-14 are included in the range, along with every test between them.
c.sql: WITH test_ratios AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, HGB, CASE WHEN T_BIL IS NOT NULL AND CRE IS NOT NULL AND CRE > 0 THEN T_BIL / CRE ELSE NULL END AS ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14'), group_stats AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM test_ratios GROUP BY CENTROMEA), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_value FROM group_stats) SELECT CENTROMEA, avg_hgb, avg_ratio, avg_ratio / (SELECT mean_value FROM overall_mean) AS normalized_ratio FROM group_stats WHERE (SELECT mean_value FROM overall_mean) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CENTROMEA

b.request: For laboratory tests with dates between and including 1985-04-22 and 1994-03-14, grouped by CENTROMEA status (with missing as a separate group), return for each status: average HGB, average T-BIL÷CRE ratio per test, and that status's average ratio divided by the mean of all statuses' average ratios, excluding null values from individual averages and returning nothing if the overall mean ratio is missing.
b.sql:
WITH lab_filtered AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN `T-BIL` IS NOT NULL AND CRE IS NOT NULL AND CRE != 0 
         THEN `T-BIL` / CRE 
         ELSE NULL 
    END AS ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14'
),
status_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    CENTROMEA,
    AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb,
    AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM lab_filtered
  GROUP BY CENTROMEA
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio
  FROM status_stats
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(CENTROMEA, 'missing') AS centromea_status,
  avg_hgb,
  avg_ratio,
  avg_ratio / overall_mean.mean_ratio AS ratio_relative_to_mean
FROM status_stats, overall_mean
WHERE overall_mean.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL

a.request: Using laboratory tests dated from 1985-04-22 through 1994-03-14 inclusive (comparing the `Date` text as stored), for each anti-centromere status (`CENTROMEA`, with a missing status as its own group), give the status, the average hemoglobin (`HGB`), the average of each test's total bilirubin-to-creatinine ratio (`T-BIL` ÷ `CRE`), and that average ratio divided by the plain mean of all the statuses' average ratios. Ignore missing values in every average, return nothing if that overall mean is missing, and don't round.
a.sql: WITH group_stats AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(HGB) as avg_hemoglobin, AVG(CASE WHEN CRE IS NOT NULL AND CRE <> 0 AND T-BIL IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(T-BIL AS FLOAT) / CAST(CRE AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14' GROUP BY CENTROMEA), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as mean_ratio FROM group_stats) SELECT CENTROMEA, avg_hemoglobin, avg_ratio, CASE WHEN (SELECT mean_ratio FROM overall_mean) IS NOT NULL THEN avg_ratio / (SELECT mean_ratio FROM overall_mean) ELSE NULL END as ratio_divided_by_mean FROM group_stats WHERE (SELECT mean_ratio FROM overall_mean) IS NOT NULL

d.request: For Laboratory tests with Date between 1985-04-22 and 1994-03-14 inclusive, grouped by CENTROMEA status (treating NULL as a distinct group), compute per status: average HGB ignoring NULLs, average T-BIL/CRE ratio ignoring NULLs, and each status's average ratio divided by the mean of all statuses' average ratios; return no results if the grand mean is NULL; do not round any values.
d.sql:
WITH group_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        CENTROMEA,
        AVG(HGB) as avg_hgb,
        AVG(CASE WHEN T-BIL IS NOT NULL AND CRE IS NOT NULL THEN T-BIL/CRE END) as avg_ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14'
    GROUP BY CENTROMEA
),
grand_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as mean_value
    FROM group_stats
)
SELECT 
    CENTROMEA,
    avg_hgb,
    avg_ratio,
    avg_ratio / (SELECT mean_value FROM grand_mean) as ratio_to_grand_mean
FROM group_stats
WHERE (SELECT mean_value FROM grand_mean) IS NOT NULL
